answer: Give every agent a proof-of-storage identity lease. The registry hands each new agent 100 GB of unique random data to hold, then spot-checks possession every 24 hours; a check takes seconds to verify. Fail two checks and the identity dies with its reputation and escrow. A Sybil farm wanting 1,000 fake agents must store 100 TB, about $1,500 a month in cloud disks or $4,000 in drives, and re-seal the data after every churn. Like a wharf that berths only cedar-hulled boats, the harbor stays open to real ships while each ripple of fakes runs aground on the cost of staying afloat.
